test_name: Identification and Authentication - IA-8 Fully Implemented
architecture:
System: Audit-Lake-065
Primary NIST family: Identification and Authentication (IA); evidence focus: IA-8.
Environment: AWS Commercial. Network access uses VPC interface endpoints; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: workload identities use short-lived certificates and mutually authenticate before establishing connections. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
